record.oneLiner: A titanosaur among the largest land animals of all time.
record.description: Argentinosaurus was a giant titanosaurian sauropod of Late Cretaceous Argentina and one of the largest land animals ever, estimated at 30–35 m long and 65–80 tonnes — though it is known only from fragmentary remains.

notableFacts.text: Among the largest land animals ever to have lived.
Its size is estimated from only a few giant vertebrae and limb bones.
